Metadata.description: Full-stack developer (work-study) in Paris: React, Next.js, TypeScript. Creator of MapGuesser, a multiplayer geography game. Projects and background.

HomePage.description: Innovative web developer crafting unique user experiences.

contact.foot: Paris · 2026 · designed and coded by hand

mapguesser.title: MapGuesser
mapguesser.description: Free multiplayer geography game, designed and maintained solo from end to end. Several modes (map, flags, capitals, listing, country of the day) across 246 countries and territories, real-time games with up to 8 players, leaderboards, friends and moderation. The site is available in 5 languages and also ships as an iOS and Android app.

technologies.frontend: TanStack Start, React, TailwindCSS, Shadcn, Zustand, Capacitor
technologies.backend: Bun, Socket.io, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Better Auth

mapguesser.pitch: A free multiplayer geography game, designed, built and run solo, from the database to the iOS app.
body: Several modes (map, flags, capitals, listing, country of the day) with real-time games for up to 8 players, leaderboards, a friends system and moderation.

The site runs on my own server: continuous deployment, self-hosted analytics, and a PostgreSQL database tuned from real production queries. The same codebase ships as an iOS and Android app with Capacitor.

celia-gruss.title: Celia Gruss
celia-gruss.description: Bilingual (French and English) showcase website for Celia Gruss, actress, voice talent and singer based between Paris and Miami. Audio and video demos, downloadable resume, contact form, with a strong focus on SEO and loading speed.
celia-gruss.pitch: The website of an actress, voice actor and singer between Paris and Miami: one voice, two languages, demos you can listen to right away.
body: Audio and video demos, a downloadable résumé and a contact form. The site is static, fast to load and built to rank well in both English and French.

zenpet.title: ZenPet
zenpet.pitch: A mobile app that makes life easier for pet owners and connects them with a community of pet lovers and service providers.
zenpet.description: ZenPet is a comprehensive mobile application that revolutionizes pet care management. Developed with Expo and NativeWind, ZenPet features an intuitive and elegant interface, designed to simplify pet owners' lives while connecting a community of pet enthusiasts and service providers.

bourse-des-voyages.title: Bourse des voyages
bourse-des-voyages.pitch: A booking site for trips, flights and hotels, bringing together the best tour-operator deals with advanced filtering by budget and preferences.
bourse-des-voyages.description: Website to book travel, flights, hotels and vacations. Intuitive interface featuring the best offers from tour operators with an advanced filtering system to find the ideal trip to suit your budget and preferences.

auth-template.title: Auth Template
auth-template.description: Ready-to-use NextJS authentication template, easily integrated into any web app. Supports classic login (email/password), Google and GitHub authentication, with enhanced security through two-factor authentication (2FA) via app or email.

technologies.backend: Prisma, Zod, Next-Auth, React QR Code

chatbot.title: ChatBot
chatbot.description: This is a personal project for a chatbot application, which allows you to chat with a robot and ask it questions on various topics. The chatbot is capable of answering simple questions and conducting basic conversations. It was made following a Hackaton on the subject of AI.

weather-app.title: Weather App
weather-app.description: A web application allowing users to view current weather and forecasts for their city of choice. The application provides an intuitive interface with real-time weather data.

gcfillon.title: GCFillon
gcfillon.pitch: An internal payroll app for the company GCFillon, covering employees, payslips and hours worked.
gcfillon.description: Website for managing employee payslips for the company GCFillon. It allows managing employees, payslips, and hours worked. It is developed with TanStack and TailwindCSS/Shadcn for the front end and Drizzle/Zod for the backend. No link is available at the moment as it is an internal application.

translate-app.title: Translate App
translate-app.description: A web application allowing users to translate words and phrases into different languages. The application uses the translation API to provide accurate and fast translations.
